rationale: INTERNAL_AUDIT_ERROR is this audit's own crawler exception catch-all (packages/audit-core/src/crawl-errors.ts: 'catch-all for any exception this module doesn't recognize'), not evidence the destination itself is broken. Publishing this as a broken_link finding would falsely blame a real destination (e.g. a well-known .gov.in site) for our own tooling failure. Rejected, not published.
